name: Can garage floor tiles be installed over damaged concrete?

mainEntity.name: Can garage floor tiles be installed over damaged concrete?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor imperfections like small cracks or uneven spots on concrete can often be addressed during subfloor preparation before tile installation. However, severely damaged concrete, such as large cracks, spalling, or significant unevenness, may require more extensive repairs, like patching or self-leveling compounds, before tiles can be laid. Proper subfloor integrity is crucial for the longevity and performance of any garage flooring system. We assess your existing concrete slab to recommend the necessary preparation steps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor concrete damage can often be prepped, but severe damage requires extensive repairs like patching or self-leveling before garage floor tiles can be properly installed.
